description: This file contains the main administrative shell component for a Flutter web application, including routing, navigation, sidebar layout, header, and session management logic.

classes.name: AdminPanelShell
classes.description: Main StatefulWidget managing the admin interface, including routing, authentication state, and layout.

classes.name: _AdminSideBar
classes.description: Stateless widget representing the collapsible sidebar menu with navigation items and logout button.

classes.name: _NavItem
classes.description: Model class representing each navigation item with an icon, label, and builder function.

classes.name: _BrandBadge
classes.description: Widget displaying the application branding icon.

classes.name: _TopSearchField
classes.description: Search input widget located in the top bar.

classes.name: _UserChip
classes.description: Widget displaying user info and avatar in the header.

methods.name: createState
methods.description: Creates the mutable state for AdminPanelShell.

methods.name: initState
methods.description: Initializes the component state, setting up routes and session check.

methods.name: _checkSession
methods.description: Asynchronously checks for valid user token to determine authentication status.

methods.name: _signout
methods.description: Handles user logout, clears session, and redirects to login page.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds the main widget tree for the admin interface, conditionally showing login or dashboard.
